Use case: style-transfer. Asset: revised CreatureGathererFX monochrome creature roster board, for comparison in the existing roster HTML.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, eight original creature species in exactly TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, with two views per species. Input image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE: expansion creature sprite atlas. Input image 3 is a SECOND STYLE REFERENCE for bells, plants and ancient relics.
Redraw all sixteen target sprites with the expansion atlas's much stronger art direction: rounded substantial volumes, chunky connected white pixel masses, confident thick black carved seams, expressive readable small faces, clean limb anatomy, evocative creature personality, sparse purposeful texture. This should look like a coherent polished classic handheld monster collection. The old drawings are too thin, diagrammatic, plain and sometimes look like blobs; give them convincing compact bodies while preserving their unmistakable silhouette and motifs. Preserve evolutionary progression and smaller baby scale, larger evolved bulk. Preserve abstract identities for circuit, item, item2 and ardu, but make their motifs readable living creatures rather than geometric icons.
Keep the original exact species ORDER, TWO COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, each cell exactly two sprites: front/three-quarter facing left on LEFT, true rear/three-quarter back view on RIGHT. Clearly different back anatomy; do not draw faces on the backs or merely mirror front views. Keep all artwork wholly within the correct cell, with at least 8% cell margin, both poses equally scaled. Exactly eight species, sixteen sprites. Black background, white creatures with black negative-space regions. Strict 1bpp, no gray shading, no color, gradients, antialias, drop shadows, floor strokes or detached particles. Hard stair-step pixel edges, intended logical 48x48 detail density, coarse features that remain readable at32x32. No thin smooth contour-only line art.
Layout identical to target: portrait board with aspect ratio5:6, two equal-width species columns and four equal-height rows. IDs only as small white block numerals at top-left in each cell, never other text. Thin horizontal white row separators. No title, no name captions, no vertical divider.
